title: README: state where skopeo officially comes from
body:
Follow-up to #2978.

skopeo has no project website, so a search for the tool has nothing authoritative to land on. At least one unaffiliated site currently fills that gap, ranking on the project name and offering its own download flow. #2978 has the details.

This adds five lines to the *Obtaining skopeo* section — the place someone about to install is already reading — naming this repository and the packages in `install.md` as the only official sources.

Two choices worth reviewing:

- **It names no specific site.** A generic statement stays correct as squatters come and go, and doesn't put the domain on a high-authority page. If you'd rather call out a specific one, say so and I'll amend.
- **It sits under *Obtaining skopeo* rather than at the top.** The top of the README gets skimmed; the install section is where the question actually arises.

The other half of #2978 is the repository's `homepage` field, which is empty. That's repo metadata rather than a file, so it needs someone with write access — one field in Settings, or `gh api -X PATCH repos/podman-container-tools/skopeo -f homepage=…`.

Also noted in #2978 and not touched here, happy to fix in a follow-up: the release badge and logo still point at `containers/skopeo` after the org transfer, and the logo is served from `cdn.rawgit.com`, which shut down in 2019.
